title: Under the person's bypass, text from outside gets the agent to write a user unit that runs at login or to write its orders into the person's blocks. Bypass asks the person nothing, so the judge reads each act in their place: one it flags is not done and nothing waits for the person, the conversation becomes suspect and bypass turns off for every conversation; one it does not answer for is refused, and a flagged conversation's acts are refused under a bypass turned on again
